scope: Selected fixed-layer arrays only; not the original complete G3 training cache. V4 file additionally contains14 bridge jobs not counted in the64 development block.
reuse_conditions: Exact token IDs through measured position; same model revision, template, layer convention, execution semantics and position. For pos_b these inputs end at that position, so full IDs must match.
Adding administrative notes, changing price/rating/order or goal before pos_b changes its causal prefix and requires a new forward.
Old no-note welfare/factual states remain valid as separate baseline/comparator states; they do not stand in for augmented descriptions.
Appending text after an unchanged measured position might preserve a causal prefix, but that position could not test sensitivity to text it has not seen.
The64 neutral examples are inspected development data and nuisance-calibration data, not fresh validation.
No individual updated candidate was fit or selected during this inventory.
